subject: Music Production
subcategory: Iconic Albums and How They Were Made
title: Daft Punk's Discovery
description: A fast breakdown of Daft Punk's Discovery for builders.

hook.text: French duo Daft Punk built a home studio and spent two years crafting their second album.

buildup.text: They filtered disco samples through vocoders and synthesizers, creating a futuristic dance sound.

discovery.text: Discovery blurred the line between sampling and original composition into something entirely new.

twist.text: Kanye West later sampled Discovery's 'Harder Better Faster Stronger,' introducing it to hip-hop fans.

climax.text: The album became a touchstone for electronic pop and influenced producers across every genre.

punchline.text: Two French robots redefined electronic pop music.

quiz.question: Which Daft Punk track did Kanye West sample?
